applicationPolicy: All 145 paths form the accepted scope. Units are explicit allowlists, not regenerated patch files.

Shared owner compares the current target base and all 145 paths before application. Missing files may be added; byte-identical files are skipped; differing files stop only that path for owner reconciliation.
Use fixed commit OR fixed patch, never both. On drifted main do not restore a whole historical tree or common paths. Apply only absent paths from this allowlist after confirming owner scope.
No changes to common route/barrel/registry/configuration paths are supplied. Current production routes and shared registry must be preserved.
Keep staging, private asset handling and publicGo=false. Public Next route wiring and production acceptance belong to shared integration owner.
